_comment: The patient raised something clinical. The agent acknowledges, does not engage, and ends the call. flag_for_staff stops the workflow: PrepCheck holds the patient for staff review and places no further calls, whatever prep_status said. Note that the free-text fields are left empty here on purpose — the instruction is not to record what a patient says about their health, and the code truncates and strips free text before it reaches a log, but the schema cannot make that impossible.
